Securo 0.18.0 with loan contracts and category splits, and pypdf 7.

## 🎨 Design

- The README groups its download buttons under titles and draws the section headings as chapter bands.

## ⚡ Improved

- **Securo 0.18.0.** Loans and financing can carry their contract terms, with a payment schedule and a payoff date. One transaction can be split across several categories by amount or percentage, recurring bills and installments included. Budgets can roll over into the next month, Reports show net cash-flow bars, and the dashboard compares a month with earlier ones. Upstream's notes for [0.17.0](https://github.com/securo-finance/securo/releases/tag/v0.17.0) and [0.18.0](https://github.com/securo-finance/securo/releases/tag/v0.18.0) have the full list.
- **Seven database migrations on the first start.** That start takes a little longer than usual. Back up the data folder before you update.
- **pypdf 7.0.0** in the backend image. dnspython is at 2.9.2, pip at 26.3, and gosu at the latest 1.20 build.

## 🐛 Fixed

- **`REGISTRATION_ENABLED=false` closes sign-up.** A value Securo saved on its first start overrode the variable, so sign-up stayed open. The update removes that saved value, and the variable decides until an administrator changes the setting in the app.
